notes.title: Two new steam achievements available only during beta version
notes.notes:
Two new achievements for those who have chosen to support this videogame even before it is released. 

 Finish one level (either Arcade Mode or Arena FPS mode). Achievement: Beta  Tester. 


 Finish 50 levels (either Arcade or Arena mode), Achievement: Pillar of Eternalia


Once the game is released, they cant be unlocked, although people who already gained them on beta will keep them unlocked on their Steam accounts.

notes.title: Release date delayed few days. Some QC/QA issues being addressed.
notes.notes:
Dear everyone, 

There were some minor input system stuff that needed to be addressed on the beta build, Steam has been most helpful reviewing it, it should be ready soon. 

A short level for the Arcade mode and the full 5 waves of enemies for one scenario in the First Person Shooter mode. 

I will probably work on a second level for the arcade mode instead of making larger the first level, the idea you can see more diverse stuff and content, tell me what you like and not, and from there once we have 5 short levels 

See the latest asset I added to the project. I intend on adding another scene / level for First Person Shooter Arena Mode on that scenario. It looks amazing for a first shooter! 

[previewyoutube=P-ZIQy93BRg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

WIth the new scenes I intend to add a second race of enemies. Ritgh now it is just Undead (commanded by vampires and there is Banshee...), I plan on adding to have the following enemies so players may choose enemy and scenario;
- Undead
- Goblins (along Trolls...)
- Dark Elves
- Monsters (e.g. giant spiders and others). 
- Chaos spawns 

Also working on adding level up system, with two extra skills / special abilities to be used on the FPS mode. It will add two extra buttons to use on the gamepad (or Keyboard...). 


Please let us know your thoughts.
